out_of_band.helpline.acknowledge.title: Acknowledge the gift — say this first
out_of_band.helpline.acknowledge.script: Thank you for telling me. What you did for that family was your own act of support, and your standing with the trust is not diminished by it in any way.
out_of_band.helpline.clarify.title: Clarify what is still expected — factual, never corrective
out_of_band.helpline.clarify.script: One separate thing to keep in mind: your assigned pool's contribution for this cycle is still expected on its own, under the Niyamavali's contribution-discipline rules (R7). The two stand apart; one does not stand in for the other.
out_of_band.helpline.boundary.title: Operator boundary — do not voice this to the member
out_of_band.helpline.boundary.instructio: Do not contact the receiving family to reconcile or verify this gift. That family's relationship with the giver is theirs to hold, and the trust does not mediate it. Do not ask the member to re-send the payment, route it another way, or repeat it through the app.
